body:
## Problem

The built-in `ChatGPT API` provider (Sign in with ChatGPT / SIWC) does not provide a way to select the OpenAI API Organization that should receive requests.

This matters for ChatGPT subscriptions that have an API credits grant attached to a specific API Organization. After signing in to ChatGPT, Magpie uses the account's OAuth token, but there is no organization selector, Organization ID setting, or `OpenAI-Organization` request header. Users cannot tell Magpie to use a different eligible API Organization.

## Source-level observation

In `internal/provider/chatgpt_api.go`:

- `siwcAPI` is fixed to `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
- `siwcCreds` stores the OAuth client, account, token, scopes, and expiry, but no organization or project ID.
- `siwcProvider` signs requests with only `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (plus session headers).
- The OAuth flow requests the `chatgpt.tokens.use.direct` scope, so this is the ChatGPT subscription-sharing provider rather than a normal API-key provider.

Relevant code:

- https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/main/internal/provider/chatgpt_api.go#L3-L17
- https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/main/internal/provider/chatgpt_api.go#L79-L90
- https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/main/internal/provider/chatgpt_api.go#L717-L743

## Expected behavior

Please consider one of these options:

1. Add an Organization ID / Project ID field to the ChatGPT API provider, if the SIWC API supports selecting them.
2. Expose a standard OpenAI API-key provider with Organization / Project configuration so users can explicitly target the API Organization containing their credits.
3. If SIWC tokens cannot select an Organization by design, show that clearly in the UI and document that this provider uses ChatGPT plan usage rather than API Organization credits.

The related #3721 issue about SIWC quota attribution appears relevant: it also shows that the ChatGPT API provider and Codex provider currently have different, partially unsupported usage/account semantics.
title: ChatGPT API provider cannot select an OpenAI Organization or API credits organization
